scripts.check: pnpm check:rust && pnpm check:frontend && pnpm check:licenses
scripts.check:mobile-native: cargo check -p vibex-mobile --locked && node scripts/check-mobile-native.mjs && node scripts/check-mobile-native.mjs --self-test
scripts.package:native-content:linux: node scripts/build-channel.mjs preview && NO_STRIP=1 cargo packager --config apps/desktop/Packager.linux.toml --formats deb,appimage && pnpm check:native-content-package
scripts.package:preview: node scripts/prepare-pdfium-runtime.mjs --offline && node scripts/build-channel.mjs preview && NO_STRIP=1 cargo packager --config apps/desktop/Packager.preview.toml --formats deb,appimage
scripts.package:rc: node scripts/prepare-pdfium-runtime.mjs --offline && node scripts/build-channel.mjs rc && NO_STRIP=1 cargo packager --config apps/desktop/Packager.rc.toml --formats deb,appimage
scripts.package:stable: node scripts/prepare-pdfium-runtime.mjs --offline && node scripts/build-channel.mjs stable && NO_STRIP=1 cargo packager --config apps/desktop/Packager.stable.toml --formats deb,appimage
scripts.release:build-smoke: cargo check -p vibex-desktop --locked && cargo check -p vibex-mobile --locked && cargo check -p vibex-relay-server --bin vibex-relay-server --locked
scripts.smoke:agents: pnpm smoke:acp:bridge-contract && pnpm smoke:codex && pnpm smoke:claude
